excerpts.author: benjaminchodroff
excerpts.content:
It took 83 epochs to change all 2133 validators using CLWP EIP-4736.

None of them were stolen by attackers.

The 10 validators that changed to a different address all belong to myself… because I hacked myself with grateful help from <@397389662085185547> who discovered an interesting libp2p attack. 

Congrats to everyone 🥳
